meaning: A video shown over the internet as it happens. Viewers watch it live, not later.
clues: You watch it while it is happening, not later.
It goes out over the internet from one place to many viewers, who can often type comments as it plays.
Gamers, musicians, and shops use it to reach many viewers at once.
If you miss it, you can sometimes watch a saved copy afterward.
It is one word with ten letters and starts with L.
assumes: A video call is a chat where people see each other
A webcam is a small camera for a computer
A TV broadcast is sent by airwaves or cable

decoys.meaning: A call where two or more people see and talk to each other on screens.
A small camera that connects to a computer and sends its video.
A program sent out by radio signals or cable to many TVs at once.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, live meant you had to be in the room. Or standing by the radio, holding your breath.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now live can mean anywhere. Tip: if you miss one, look for a saved copy posted later.
